rows.difficultyReason: Construct two cost expressions, choose the strict comparison, solve their crossing and select the first admissible whole session count.
rows.independentDerivation: Let n count sessions per person. Hyper-Mobile exceeds Extreme-Karting when 20+53n>99+39n, giving 14n>79 and n>79/14. The least integer is 6. At 5 sessions the costs are 285 and 294; at 6 they are 338 and 333.

rows.difficultyReason: Audit successive transformations, distinguishing an incorrect expansion and negative-division reversal from valid steps carrying an earlier error.
rows.independentDerivation: Expansion gives 2(3-2x)=6-4x, so the second displayed line introduces an error. Multiplication by 5 and subtraction of 5 correctly follow the erroneous preceding expressions. Dividing -4x<=65 by -4 must reverse the relation, so the final line introduces another error. Solving the original independently gives 6-4x<=70, then -4x<=64 and x>=-16.
findings: The source key identifies the two error-introducing lines correctly.

rows.difficultyReason: The harder part requires reversing under negative multiplication, collecting variables from both sides and translating the inclusive solution into a ray.
rows.independentDerivation: (i) Subtracting 3 gives x<-2: open endpoint at -2, ray left. (ii) Multiplying by -5 reverses the relation: x-12>=-5x. Thus 6x>=12 and x>=2: closed endpoint at 2, ray right.
